issues.problem: Frame used <giver>に, so the distractors あげました and さしあげました still formed grammatical sentences (receiver and giver swapped); only the English excluded them, against the rule that the sentence itself must decide the direction.
issues.action: Changed the source particle to から (<receiver>は<giver>からXをもらいました), which is equally natural with もらう and makes あげる / さしあげる plainly wrong in the Japanese too; updated 'why' to match.

issues.problem: Checked all 294 combinations: in-group giver (私 or family) to outsider; あげました right throughout; くれました and くださいました wrong for an in-group giver; もらいました flips the direction against 'gave'. English agreement and articles correct; f=0 is the only slot.

Checked all 294 combinations: outsider giver が to 私 or family に; くれました right throughout; あげました / やりました wrong towards the speaker's in-group; もらいました flips the direction against 'gave'. English correct; f=0 is the only slot.
